article_notes: 45 dogs with acute B. canis babesiosis (smear only), Zhytomyr, Ukraine, graded into three author-defined stages by disease duration and parasitaemia; GGT, urea and creatinine compared with healthy controls and between stages (Tukey's test; significance by superscripts only). Control group size is 16 in Methods but 20 in Results and tables. Parasitaemia and duration are the stage definition, so not extracted as markers. Dogs were treated as outpatients; sample timing relative to treatment not stated. Histology is from dogs that died, with no comparison by stage. Infected-vs-healthy comparisons counted as skipped.

severity_definitions.label: stage I / stage II / stage III of acute babesiosis
severity_definitions.definition: Author-defined stages of acute B. canis babesiosis by duration of disease and invasion intensity (parasitaemia): stage I 1-2 days and 2-4%; stage II 3-4 days and 5-8%; stage III 5-6 days and >9%. Components = 'other': disease duration and parasitaemia. Pairwise rows compare stage III (most severe) with stage I; stage II values are given in the statistic.
severity_definitions.quote: the first stage – duration of the disease 1–2 days with an invasion intensity of 2–4%; the second stage – duration of 3–4 days with an invasion intensity of 5–8%; the third stage – duration of 5–6 days with an invasion intensity exceeding 9%.
